snippet.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth - (1978) - Apple 2 - gameplay
snippet.description:
Greg Hassett © 1978 
[Computer] Apple II
Emulator:  MAME 0.220

A simple BASIC programmed text-adventure game.  The very early "Treasure Hunt" variety - but its not frustrating and only has a few puzzles.  Good historical game, as it came out the same year that "Adventureland" by Scott Adams made so many waves.   175 of 175 WIN!  (but on the TRS-80 version)
